https://tile.openstreetmap.org.purpose: Street tile context for the retained evidence atlas; no scientific dataset is sent to the tile service.
https://tile.openstreetmap.org.activation: Street tiles are requested when the atlas opens with its retained street basemap, or when the reader selects Street. Requests disclose IP address and viewed tile coordinates.
https://tile.openstreetmap.org.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; attribution remains visible in the original Leaflet control.

https://tile.opentopomap.org.purpose: Terrain tile context for the retained evidence atlas; no scientific dataset is sent to the tile service.
https://tile.opentopomap.org.activation: Terrain tiles are requested only when the reader selects Terrain. Requests disclose IP address and viewed tile coordinates.
https://tile.opentopomap.org.attribution: OpenTopoMap and OpenStreetMap contributors; attribution remains visible in the original Leaflet control.
